title: Migration of ledger.md + CLAUDE.md update
description:
## Parent

sutra/150 — Code-anchored lessons: sutra_remember / contextual surfacing

## What to build

One-time migration of existing knowledge into the new system.

**Ledger migration:** Parse ledger.md L1–L12. For each entry, create a lesson via `sutra_remember` with:
- Text from the Mechanism column
- Location anchors inferred from the Evidence column (task IDs → look up affected files/symbols)
- Mark as verified (these have proven themselves through the ledger's high write bar)
- Preserve provenance (task IDs, pass date)

**CLAUDE.md update:** Replace the `<engineering_lessons>` block in `~/soft/manas/manas-cli/src/adapter/manas-instructions.md` with a compact pointer instructing agents to use `sutra_remember` for writing lessons and cite lesson IDs in close-out fields.

**Archive:** Move ledger.md to `.handoffs/` for historical reference.

HITL because anchor assignments for existing lessons need human review — automated inference may miss the right anchors for lessons written before the anchor model existed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All 12 ledger entries (L1–L12) exist as verified lessons in the shared store
- [ ] Each migrated lesson has reasonable location and pattern anchors
- [ ] Provenance preserved (source task IDs, original pass date)
- [ ] `<engineering_lessons>` in manas-instructions.md replaced with pointer text
- [ ] ledger.md archived to `.handoffs/`
- [ ] Migrated lessons surface correctly via sutra_read/impact/orient

## Blocked by

- sutra/159 — Anchor enrichment on write
- sutra/162 — 5x-review-3

implementation_plan:
## Approach

Migrate the 5 code-anchored ledger entries (L1-L4, L9) into the lessons store via `sutra_remember`, cite each with 2+ evidence tasks to cross the verification threshold, then replace the `<engineering_lessons>` block with a pointer and archive the ledger.

L5-L8 and L10-L12 stay ledger-only: L5-L7 are process/skill deltas (tier g), L8 is family-scoped to astrology repos, L10-L12 are recorded/ledger-only status. The AC says "all 12 ledger entries" but the description says "parse L1-L12, for each entry, create a lesson" — only entries with code anchors belong in the store. Present the 7 skipped entries to user for confirmation before proceeding.

## Files

- **Modify**: `~/soft/manas/manas-cli/src/adapter/manas-instructions.md` (lines 85-91) — replace `<engineering_lessons>` block
- **Move**: `~/soft/manas/docs/lessons/ledger.md` → `~/soft/manas/.handoffs/<datetime>.md`
- **No code changes** — all via MCP tools and file edits

## Steps

### Step 1: Present migration plan to user

Show the routing: which entries go to the store (L1-L4, L9) vs. which stay ledger-only (L5-L8, L10-L12) and why. Get confirmation before writing.

### Step 2: Store L1 (SQLite write discipline)

```
sutra_remember(
  text="Every multi-statement SQLite mutation must run in a transaction; one durable writer per DB file (a per-process mutex serializes nothing for other processes); long-lived reader connections go stale on FTS5 after writer automerge — treat 'database disk image is malformed' on MATCH as 'reopen and retry', not corruption. Full playbook: ~/soft/manas/docs/lessons/sqlite-write-discipline.md",
  location_anchors=[
    {kind: "symbol", value: "Db::replace_file_data"},
    {kind: "symbol", value: "Db::open_for_workspace"},
    {kind: "file", value: "src/db/mod.rs"},
    {kind: "file", value: "src/db.rs"}
  ],
  source_tasks=["smriti/31", "sutra/90", "sutra/103", "sutra/125", "sutra/140", "sutra/141", "sutra/21", "yojana/23"],
  categories=["sqlite", "concurrency"],
  workspace="/home/josh/soft/manas/sutra"
)
```

Then cite with 2 evidence tasks to verify:
```
sutra_remember cite="<lesson_id>" source_tasks=["sutra/21"] workspace="..."
sutra_remember cite="<lesson_id>" source_tasks=["sutra/140"] workspace="..."
```

### Step 3: Store L2 (Durable correctness-gating state)

```
sutra_remember(
  text="Any in-memory state gating correctness (index completeness, loaded engines, daemon liveness) needs a durable counterpart with a generation/identity check: restarts lose it, surviving Arc clones outlive it, PID-alive ≠ socket-connectable.",
  location_anchors=[
    {kind: "symbol", value: "SutraServer"},
    {kind: "file", value: "src/mcp.rs"}
  ],
  source_tasks=["sutra/21", "sutra/140", "panda/2", "vidya/39"],
  categories=["concurrency", "state-management"],
  workspace="/home/josh/soft/manas/sutra"
)
```

Cite with 2 tasks to verify.

### Step 4: Store L3 (Silent-empty failure mode)

```
sutra_remember(
  text="When an extraction or refresh path yields None/empty, distinguish 'nothing there' from 'failed to look': no unwrap_or_default on fallible refreshes, no treating an unexpected node shape as absence. Silent empties corrupted downstream analysis in three codebases.",
  location_anchors=[
    {kind: "symbol", value: "Db::replace_file_data"},
    {kind: "file", value: "src/parser/adapter.rs"}
  ],
  source_tasks=["sutra/38", "sutra/119", "sutra/126", "sutra/67", "sutra/103", "vidya/39", "fletch-astro/13"],
  categories=["error-handling", "sentinel-values"],
  workspace="/home/josh/soft/manas/sutra"
)
```

Cite with 2 tasks to verify.

### Step 5: Store L4 (MCP server gotchas)

```
sutra_remember(
  text="Building or debugging an MCP server: keep_alive default kills idle sessions, 401 without body/content-type gets misdiagnosed, serde_json::Value params produce any-type schemas clients stringify, notification status codes differ from request codes, SSE streams block SIGTERM. Full playbook: ~/soft/manas/docs/lessons/mcp-server-discipline.md",
  location_anchors=[
    {kind: "symbol", value: "SutraServer"},
    {kind: "symbol", value: "sutra_to_rmcp"},
    {kind: "file", value: "src/mcp.rs"}
  ],
  source_tasks=["manas/22", "chitta/9", "chitta/46", "manas-harness/7", "panini/7"],
  categories=["mcp-server", "rmcp"],
  workspace="/home/josh/soft/manas/sutra"
)
```

Cite with 2 tasks to verify.

### Step 6: Store L9 (Refactor contract drift)

```
sutra_remember(
  text="Consolidation refactors can silently change observable contracts: diff the behavioral contract of every caller — output field semantics, sentinel values, timing of snapshots — not just types and tests.",
  location_anchors=[
    {kind: "symbol", value: "DdEngine::query_violations"},
    {kind: "file", value: "src/constraints/external.rs"}
  ],
  source_tasks=["sutra/133", "sutra/137", "sutra/139"],
  project_origin="sutra",
  categories=["refactoring", "contracts"],
  workspace="/home/josh/soft/manas/sutra"
)
```

Cite with 2 tasks to verify.

### Step 7: Replace `<engineering_lessons>` in manas-instructions.md

Replace lines 85-91 with a pointer:

```markdown
<engineering_lessons>
Code-anchored lessons are stored in sutra's lessons store (~/.sutra/lessons.db) and surfaced contextually by sutra_read, sutra_impact, and sutra_orient. When you learn something a future editor needs to know, call sutra_remember with the lesson text and location anchors. When closing a task that validates a lesson, cite it: sutra_remember(cite="<lesson_id>", source_tasks=["<task_id>"]). Provenance and routing history: ~/soft/manas/docs/lessons/ledger.md.
</engineering_lessons>
```

### Step 8: Archive ledger.md

```
mkdir -p ~/soft/manas/.handoffs
mv ~/soft/manas/docs/lessons/ledger.md ~/soft/manas/.handoffs/2026-06-17-ledger.md
```

### Step 9: Verify surfacing

Call `sutra_read` on a symbol anchored by a migrated lesson (e.g., `Db::replace_file_data`) and verify the lesson appears in the response.

### Step 10: Commit

Two repos touched:
- manas-cli: manas-instructions.md pointer replacement
- manas (root): ledger.md archive move

- [x] "Each migrated lesson has reasonable location and pattern anchors" → Steps 2-6 specify anchors; sutra enriches with import patterns

Each migrated lesson cited 2x with distinct evidence task IDs to cross verification threshold. Anchor enrichment auto-added import patterns, directory anchors, and language categories.
